newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Tyumentelekom board approves ADR issue.
newsitem.headline: Russia Tyumentelekom board approves ADR issue.

text.p: The board of directors of Russian regional telecoms company Tyumentelekom has voted to issue a level one American Depositary Receipt (ADR) to allow foreign trade of local shares, a top company official said on Wednesday.
Nadezhda Kapelistaya, deputy general director of the West Siberian telecoms company, said shareholders, who do not need to approve the issue, would meet on May 28 for their annual meeting.
Kapelistaya said the company was considering using a 10 percent packet of shares controlled by the company for the ADR issue. No other details of the issue were available.
AO Tyumentelekom's 1996 net profit rose to 23.90 billion roubles on an accruals basis from 18.58 billion in 1995.
Kapelistaya said Tyumentelekom's legal consultant on the issue was Cleary, Gottlieb, Steen & Hamilton.
Tyumentelekom is traded on the RTS-2 Russian Trading System market for less liquid shares. Its ordinary shares were quoted at $3.0/$3.9 on Tuesday.
